d.title: Tropical-Rouge! Precure Movie: Yuki no Princess to Kiseki no Yubiwa!
d.jp: 映画 トロピカル〜ジュ!プリキュア 雪のプリンセスと奇跡の指輪!
syn: Tropical Rouge! Precure Snow Princess and The Miracle Ring!
d.synopsis: The story takes place in the wintry land of Shantia, with Manatsu and the others invited to the land by its princess Sharon. But as they arrive, a mysterious monster attacks Shantia, and it is closed off to outsiders.
